intake.business_request_raw: Magicbox adopt-mode increment — verify Developer auto-approves Architect decisions and skips sealed TSM modules.
assumptions: Sealed TSM modules are clearly defined and identifiable.
Architect decisions are logged and accessible for automation.

domain_invariants.statement: Define explicit error handling and observability requirements.
Map acceptance criteria to executable test types.

scenarios.name: Auto-approve Architect decisions
gherkin: Given an Architect decision is logged
When the system processes the decision
Then the decision is automatically approved
And an approval event is logged

Then the sealed modules are flagged

When the system encounters the error

open_questions.question: Are there existing operational constraints or integration dependencies not listed?
What are target latency, throughput, and availability SLOs?

risks.description: Potential misidentification of sealed TSM modules.
risks.mitigation: Implement thorough testing and validation processes.

risks.description: Automated approval process may fail due to unforeseen errors.
risks.mitigation: Include robust error handling and logging mechanisms.

out_of_scope: Changes to the core business logic outside of modernization scope.
Development of new features unrelated to modernization.

input_contract.business_objective: Magicbox adopt-mode increment — verify Developer auto-approves Architect decisions and skips sealed TSM modules.

relationships: LegacyInput contract must map deterministically to ModernizedOutput contract

non_negotiables: Define explicit error handling and observability requirements.
Map acceptance criteria to executable test types.

features.title: Automate Architect Decision Approval
features.gherkin:
Feature: Automate Architect Decision Approval
Scenario: Auto-approve Architect decisions
Given an Architect decision is logged
When the system processes the decision
Then the decision is automatically approved
And an approval event is logged

features.title: Identify Sealed TSM Modules
features.gherkin:
Feature: Identify Sealed TSM Modules
Scenario: Flag sealed TSM modules
Given a list of modules
When the system identifies sealed modules
Then the sealed modules are flagged
And excluded from modernization

features.title: Maintain Legacy Behavior
features.gherkin:
Feature: Maintain Legacy Behavior
Scenario: Ensure legacy behavior post-modernization
Given the system is modernized
When legacy features are tested
Then they function as before
And no regressions are found

features.title: Error Handling in Modernization
features.gherkin:
Feature: Error Handling in Modernization
Scenario: Handle errors gracefully
Given an error occurs during modernization
When the system encounters the error
Then it logs the error
And recovers without data loss

must.title: Security Enhancement
must.description: Enhance security measures during the modernization process.
must.metric: Zero critical vulnerabilities in security scans.
acceptance_criteria: Security scans show no critical vulnerabilities.
All identified vulnerabilities are remediated before deployment.
Security best practices are documented and followed.

must.title: Reliability and Uptime
must.description: Ensure high reliability and uptime during and after modernization.
acceptance_criteria: Contingency plans in place for potential downtime.

should.title: Performance Optimization
should.description: Ensure the system performance is optimized post-modernization.
should.metric: System response time under 200ms for 95% of requests.
acceptance_criteria: Load tests show improved performance metrics.
No degradation in system performance post-modernization.
should.verification: Load test at 10× expected peak; measure p95/p99

should.title: Scalability Assurance
should.description: Ensure the system is scalable to handle increased load post-modernization.
should.metric: System supports 2x current user load without performance degradation.
acceptance_criteria: Scalability tests confirm system can handle increased load.
No performance issues under peak load conditions.
Scalability metrics are documented and monitored.
should.verification: Scalability test with double current load

should.title: Usability Improvements
should.description: Enhance the usability of the system for end-users post-modernization.
should.metric: User satisfaction score of 8/10 or higher in post-modernization surveys.
acceptance_criteria: Usability tests conducted with positive outcomes.
